definitions.text:
rule isVowelBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), Bool(false))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("a"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("e"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("i"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("o"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("u"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("A"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("E"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("I"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("O"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    While(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("U"))),
      Assign(Name("result"), Bool(true))
      Assign(Name("ch"), Str("")))
    Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: This macro equation defines the fresh verification symbol getClosestLoopBody as the exact constructor-form loop body.
definitions.text:
rule getClosestLoopBody =>
    While(
      BoolOp("and",
        ( UnaryOp("not", Name("found")),
          Call(
            Name("_is_vowel"),
            Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i"))),
          UnaryOp(
            "not",
            Call(
              Name("_is_vowel"),
              Subscript(
                Name("word"),
                BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
          UnaryOp(
            "not",
            Call(
              Name("_is_vowel"),
              Subscript(
                Name("word"),
                BinOp("+", Name("i"), Int(1))))),
          .Exprs)),
      Assign(Name("result"), Subscript(Name("word"), Name("i")))
      Assign(Name("found"), Bool(true)))
    Assign(Name("i"), BinOp("-", Name("i"), Int(1)))

definitions.rationale: This macro equation defines the fresh verification symbol getClosestBody as the exact constructor-form function body.
definitions.text:
rule getClosestBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), Str(""))
    Assign(Name("found"), Bool(false))
    Assign(
      Name("i"),
      BinOp("-", Call(Name("len"), Name("word")), Int(2)))
    While(Compare(Name("i"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))), getClosestLoopBody)
    Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: This macro equation defines the fresh verification symbol getClosestProgram as the exact constructor-form two-function module.
definitions.text:
rule getClosestProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef(
        "_is_vowel",
        Params("ch"),
        isVowelBody)
      FuncDef(
        "get_closest_vowel",
        Params("word"),
        getClosestBody))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the fresh summary function closestCandidate as the singleton sequence containing the selected code.
This equation defines the fresh predicate vowelPred by the disjunction of the ten case-sensitive ASCII vowel codes.
definitions.text:
rule vowelPred(C)
    => C ==Int 97
     orBool C ==Int 101
     orBool C ==Int 105
     orBool C ==Int 111
     orBool C ==Int 117
     orBool C ==Int 65
     orBool C ==Int 69
     orBool C ==Int 73
     orBool C ==Int 79
     orBool C ==Int 85

definitions.rationale: This is the true guarded defining equation of the fresh total predicate isVowelCode.
This is the false guarded defining equation of the fresh total predicate isVowelCode; together with the preceding complementary case it completes the definition.
definitions.text:
rule isVowelCode(C)
    => false
    requires notBool vowelPred(C)

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the fresh predicate closestQualifies from the current and neighboring vowel tests.
definitions.text:
rule closestQualifies(CS, I)
    => isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I))
       andBool notBool isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
       andBool notBool isVowelCode(intSeqAt(CS, I +Int 1))

definitions.rationale: This simplification equation is the guarded base case defining the fresh recursive summary closestScan.
definitions.text:
rule closestScan(_CS, I, R, _F) => R
    requires I <=Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This simplification equation defines the found=true recursive case of the fresh summary closestScan.
definitions.text:
rule closestScan(CS, I, R, true)
    => closestScan(CS, I -Int 1, R, true)
    requires I >Int 0
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This simplification equation defines the qualifying-vowel recursive case of the fresh summary closestScan, recording the candidate and setting found to true.
definitions.text:
rule closestScan(CS, I, R, false)
    => closestScan(
         CS,
         I -Int 1,
         closestCandidate(CS, I),
         true)
    requires I >Int 0
     andBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I))
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I -Int 1))
     andBool notBool vowelPred(intSeqAt(CS, I +Int 1))
    [simplification]
